name: Parana
source: Instituto Nacional del Agua (INA) alert system a5 API; Prefectura Naval Argentina gauges
datum: m above the local gauge zero (cero de escala); INA lists the zero at 9.432 m IGN (Argentine national vertical datum)
license: INA alert system (alerta.ina.gob.ar); data from Prefectura Naval Argentina gauges. No license is stated on the API or site. Credit INA and Prefectura Naval Argentina; clear reuse terms before publishing.
notes: INA series 29 ('medición directa', variable 'Altura hidrométrica'), station Paraná (INA station 29, PNA code 230), owner PNA.
INA publishes no per-value quality flag, so every value is marked measured. This includes the most recent days, which INA may still correct.
47031 raw observations. Days with more than one reading (averaged to a daily mean): 1376, from 2016-01-04 to 2026-07-01. Before that each day has a single reading.

Most common local timestamp by decade: {1900: '07:00', 1910: '07:00', 1920: '07:00', 1930: '07:00', 1940: '07:00', 1950: '07:00', 1960: '07:00', 1970: '07:00', 1980: '06:00', 1990: '06:00', 2000: '04:00', 2010: '04:00', 2020: '00:00'}. These are the times INA stored; the uniform 07:00 before 1980 looks like a loading convention, not a documented reading hour.
INA alert thresholds for this gauge: alert 4.7 m, evacuation 5 m, low water 1.61 m.

measurement_history.fact: INA/UTN report: the Prefectura series for Parana starts 31 Dec 1902, with 543 missing days to June 2024.
Prefectura gauge zero is 9.432 m IGN (INA-IGN survey, 2018).
A second national-network gauge about 500 m away agrees closely day to day, apart from scattered single days up to 1.5 m off; after 2020 the two differ by less than 0.25 m.
Not found: early reading hours and readings per day, gauge moves, telemetry start, early accuracy statement.

public_notes: This daily record starts in 1902; the first decade has about one day in ten missing. The agency publishes no review flags, so recent values may still be corrected.
